描述_EN: according to a number of later sources, the orchard factory was set up in the new capital, beijing, at the beginning of the ming dynasty in order to produce the finest carved lacquer. paintings reveal that folding chairs were used by ming emperors when on their travels.he might be hunting, inspecting territories or making sacrifices at the tombs of his ancestors. one of the most renowned of all imperial palace workshops was the orchard factory. this chair carries the mark of the xuande reign period (1426-35), although stylistically it would appear to date from rather later, towards the mid-16th century. the chair may be a product of that workshop. the chair is decorated with patterns of five-clawed dragons and lotus flowers. this folding armchair is among the museum's most important chinese treasures.
描述_ZN: 根据一些后来的资料，果园厂是在明朝初年在新首都北京设立的，目的是为了生产最好的雕漆。 画作显示，明朝皇帝在旅行时使用折叠椅。他可能是在打猎、视察领土或在祖先的坟墓前进行祭祀。 所有皇宫工坊中最著名的一个是果园工厂。 这把椅子带有宣德年间（1426-35）的标记，尽管从风格上看，它似乎是在更晚的时候，即16世纪中期。 这把椅子可能是那个工厂的产品。 这把椅子上装饰着五爪龙和莲花的图案。 这个折叠扶手椅是博物馆最重要的中国珍品之一。
